name: smart-parking-system
description: IoT Smart Parking System with NodeMCU ESP8266, Node.js, Express, SQLite, and Real-Time Purple Dashboard

scripts.postinstall: node -e "if (process.platform === 'linux') { try { console.log('Compiling sqlite3 from source for Linux/Render...'); require('child_process').execSync('npm rebuild sqlite3 --build-from-source', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch(e) { console.warn('Native rebuild warning:', e.message); } }"
